name: PdxRadioGroup
description:
Single selection across the `<pdx-radio>` elements it holds, with one tab stop and arrow keys that
move and check, and the chosen value takes part in a form.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: size
members.description: Size of the control (e.g. sm, md, lg).

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the group. Without it, a <pdx-label> right before the group names it.

members.name: orientation
members.description: vertical (the default) or horizontal: the radios in a column or a row.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size of the control (e.g. sm, md, lg).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the group. Without it, a <pdx-label> right before the group names it.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: vertical (the default) or horizontal: the radios in a column or a row.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssStates.name: invalid
cssStates.description: `error` is set; every radio is aria-invalid.

cssStates.name: disabled
cssStates.description: `disabled` is set; the group is aria-disabled and every radio disabled.
